description: This file contains data class definitions related to chat messages, sessions, history, and attachments for an Android application, defining the core data structures used in the chat module.

classes.name: ChatMessage
classes.description: Represents a message exchanged in a chat, including an identifier, role, content, and timestamp.

classes.name: ChatMessageContent
classes.description: Contains the content of a chat message, supporting multiple types such as text and files.

classes.name: ChatPendingToolCall
classes.description: Models a pending call to an external tool during a chat interaction, with relevant identifiers and timing.

classes.name: ChatSessionEntry
classes.description: Represents a saved chat session with key identifiers and display information.

classes.name: ChatHistory
classes.description: Encapsulates the history of messages within a specific chat session.

classes.name: OutgoingAttachment
classes.description: Represents an attachment to be sent in chat, including media type and base64 content.
